Native tracker dependencies packaged only by the Termux build.
Versions are pinned in termux-native-dependencies.json at the library root.
Sources and packaging recipes: https://github.com/termux/termux-packages/tree/master/packages
libopenmpt: https://lib.openmpt.org/
mpg123: https://www.mpg123.de/
libogg/libvorbis: https://xiph.org/
libc++: https://libcxx.llvm.org/
